title: Should I get a tattoo or not?

commenti.body:
Would you get embarrased if some hypothetical Bergman aficionado asked you about a film you haven't seen?

If the answer is yes, and the potential feeling of temporary (and unnecessary) embarrasment is too much too bear, don't get it. If it isn't get it.

But ultimately, you should just get what you love.

Go for it mate! 
I've got three tattoos of three films that have impacted me deeply even if they weren't the best from the directors or even my favourite films of all time. What truly matters is the impact the film had on you, that's what your tattoo symbolises.

I think if it's an important film to you then that's all that matters. I will, however, caution that I got a quote from 1984 tattooed on me when I was 21 because I thought it was radical and thought-provoking at the time. Now, in my 30s, I deeply regret it and am saving to get a cover-up.

Be mindful and ask yourself how you'd feel about the Bergmann tattoo in like 15 years. That's my best advice

You aren't getting a Bergman tattoo, you're getting a Seventh Seal tattoo. I don't think anyone expects someone to have seen a director's entire filmography just because someone really likes one of theirs.

It’s literally just a tattoo, don’t put so much stress on it. It’s good to think about what you want, not about others. As for not having seen all the films, I mean does it really matter? 

If the tattoo is about the Seventh Seal and you’ve seen and love that movie, then it should be no problem for you getting something you love

Yes, do it! No one’s gonna stop you on the street and challenge you Bergman’s filmography like some sort of gatekeeper. If anyone sees it and knows what it is, they’re gonna say “sick tat dude!” It doesn’t matter what other people think, if it’s important to you then that’s all that matters. 

I have a big piece on my lower leg related to 2001: A Space Odyssey and I love it. I’ve seen every Kubrick film but two but I don’t mind- 2001 will always mean a lot to me.

My advice is always to think about it, then give it some time and think again.

I have tattoos that I got after long consideration and 30+ years later I still love them.

Never get one for fashion or to impress others. They are personal and stay with you forever. 

That said, if you are set on getting it then it's only ever your decision.
